notes.title: 1.1.2.3 Minor Update
notes.content:
This update fixes stats inconsistencies with dice bought with the keyboard shortcut (thanks YT_Clip_it and rialgar for reporting the issue).

That's all for now, if you have any other suggestions or find any other issues let me know!

notes.title: 1.1 Update Live!
notes.content:
Hello there, it's been a while, this update introduces, and changes a few things, here is the complete list:

[list]
[*] Added new currency "DICE SHARDS" which can be used to instantly buy any dice tier
[*] Added new tiers
[*] Added one new golden die mini game
[*] Added one new random clickeable event that gives dice shards
[*] Added tutorials for golden die mini games
[*] Added tutorial for Meta Dice
[*] Added shop refresh (you can reroll the items inside the shop)
[*] Added a setting for the table to resize or not
[*] Added a setting to toggle Ctrl, Shift and Alt actions
[*] Reworked the Meta Dice interface
[*] Changed Meta Dice effect multipliers (they now do not work with each other, preventing crazy scores)
[*] Changed multiplier display so that instead of a chain of 2x2x2x2... it shows the final multiplier
[*] Changed shop base prices so that they feel more fair
[*] Ending the play on Meta Dice will now give you an extra boost corresponding to a % the remaining rolls
[*] Fixed a bug that made the game open in window mode on the bottom right corner of the screen at full screen resolution and you could only see one quarter of it
[*] Fixed Ctrl or Shift upgraded dice not counting towards the stats for the game nor for the achievements
[*] Fixed stats highscore pictures score discrepancies
[*] Fixed visual bug when a dice merchant was waiting for you and a new one would spawn
[*] Fixed a visual bug related to the ascension requirements panel
[*] Dice tier list can now be dragged with the mouse
[*] Autocrafting dice will be saved, so next time you open the game it will go back to buying and upgrading
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

I will be reading all your ideas for the game, and checking the leaderboards..
Have fun!

notes.title: 1.0.3.1 Update Live!
notes.content:
Small update that reverts Dice merchant disappearing after 30 seconds.

Also, their spawn time has been reduced, shouldn't take longer than 15 minutes for one of them to spawn.

That's all for now, be back in a couple of weeks!

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update Live!
notes.content:
This update fixes/changes the following:
[list]
[*] Leaderbaords!
[*] Balance should be... well.. more balanced
[/list]

Additions:
[list]
[*] 2 new merchants, making it a total of 3, each one of them with better or worse items
[/list]

What is next?
[list]
[*] Shop refreshing
[*] More golden die minigames
[*] A new currency to stop the game from being so idle (you will be able to earn it by playing, and you will be able to spend it on making progress faster)
[/list]

When is this next update coming?
It shouldn't take long, but I will be out for a couple of weeks. I hope I can have this ready by mid December, will be reading all your reviews and comments in the meanwhile. If you have ideas for the game or want to discuss it with other players, join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/YyhtyeSVKe]discord[/url]!

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update live!
notes.content:
This update fixes the following:
[list]
[*] Modified encryption system (should stop game file losses)
[*] Fixed all reported crashes
[*] Fixed meta dice inventory "throw button" issue. Where selecting a dive from the bottom will instantly throw your dice
[*] Fixed meta dice inventory going crazy while resizing the game window
[*] Fixed duplication bug with while the "better autoupgrader" boost is on
[*] Fixed automatic buying panel not showing minutes sometimes
[*] Changed the wording for ascension upgrade tier requirement from "A MINIMUM OF X DICE AT LEVEL Y" to "A MINIMUM OF X DICE AT LEVEL Y (higher levels will still count)". I hope this makes it clearer that higher tiers will still count.
[/list]

Next patch will address the following:
[list]
[*] Leaderboards
[*] Ascension balance
[*] Some more bug fixing and polish
[/list]

I am reading all your comments on discussions and on the discord, thanks for all the ideas and feedback for the game!
